item.title: Drake’s ‘ICEMAN’ Scores Third Week Atop Billboard 200
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music update. I'm your host, and today we're diving into the top hits on the Billboard 200 chart. Let's see who's trending and who's making waves in the music world."
[Music transition]
Host: "For the third week in a row, Drake's 'ICEMAN' is holding strong at number one, with 171,000 equivalent album units earned in the United States. This is one of five Drake albums to spend at least three weeks at the top spot, and his first since 'Certified Lover Boy' in 2021. Notably, his album 'Views' still holds the record with 13 weeks at number one back in 2016."
[Music clip: Drake - "ICEMAN"]
Host: "Meanwhile, Paul McCartney is making his mark with his new album 'The Boys of Dungeon Lane', debuting at number five. This is his 22nd top 10 album, and it's led by the single 'Days We Left Behind'. The album's first-week sales were boosted by its availability in 18 physical variants, including over 10 vinyl editions."
[Music clip: Paul McCartney - "Days We Left Behind"]
Host: "Aespa is also joining the top 10 with their new album 'LEMONADE' at number nine. And let's take a look at the rest of the top 10: Ella Langley's 'Dandelion' is steady at number two, Morgan Wallen's 'I'm the Problem' rises to number three, and Noah Kahan's 'The Great Divide' falls to number four."
[Music transition]
Host: "That's all for today's update. For more music news and chart info, follow @billboard and @billboardcharts on social media. And don't forget to check out the full Billboard 200 chart on their website. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!"
[Outro music plays]
